cards.ex: The grant will help offset the costs of the research project.
cards.exUz: Grant tadqiqot loyihasining xarajatlarini qoplashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni qisman yoki to'liq qoplash, kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The government needs to show more fiscal responsibility.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ko'proq moliyaviy mas'uliyatni ko'rsatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Pulni to'g'ri boshqarish va mas'uliyat bilan sarflash.

cards.ex: We should build up a rainy day fund in case of emergencies.
cards.exUz: Biz favqulodda vaziyatlar uchun qora kun jamg'armasini yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan xarajatlar uchun ajratilgan pul.

cards.ex: He bootstrapped his business with just a few thousand dollars.
cards.exUz: U o'z biznesini atigi bir necha ming dollar bilan boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi moliyalashtirishsiz biznesni boshlash va rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: The company is struggling to balance the books this quarter.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya shu chorakda hisoblarni muvozanatlash uchun kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kirim va chiqimni tenglashtirish, moliyaviy muvozanatga erishish.

cards.ex: We're going to have to tighten our belts this year.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yil xarajatlarimizni qisqartirishga majbur bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni qisqartirish, tejash rejimiga o'tish.

cards.ex: Many people are living paycheck to paycheck these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda ko'p odamlar oylikdan oylikkacha yashashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Barcha pulini har oy oxirida sarflab, jamg'armasiz yashamoq.

cards.ex: The government needs to be more fiscally prudent to avoid future crises.
cards.exUz: Hukumat kelajakdagi inqirozlardan qochish uchun moliyaviy jihatdan tejamkorroq bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Pulni oqilona sarflaydigan va tejaydigan odam yoki siyosat.

cards.ex: The company's stock price reflected their plummeting profits.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning aktsiya narxi ularning keskin pasaygan foydasini aks ettirdi.
cards.uzDef: Foydaning juda tez va keskin kamayishi.

cards.ex: A large portion of the country's budget goes towards debt servicing.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat byudjetining katta qismi qarzga xizmat ko'rsatishga ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni to'lash uchun foiz va asosiy summani o'z vaqtida to'lash jarayoni.

cards.ex: Rising consumer confidence usually leads to increased spending.
cards.exUz: Xaridorlarning ishonchi oshishi odatda xarajatlarning ko'payishiga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Xaridorlarning iqtisodiyotga bo'lgan ishonch darajasi.

cards.ex: The government implemented austerity measures to reduce the budget deficit.
cards.exUz: Hukumat byudjet taqchilligini kamaytirish uchun tejamkorlik choralarini ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat tomonidan xarajatlarni kamaytirish va soliqni oshirish siyosati.

cards.ex: The government hopes these tax cuts will jump-start the economy.
cards.exUz: Hukumat bu soliq imtiyozlari iqtisodiyotni jonlantirishiga umid qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotni tezroq rivojlantirish uchun chora ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Small businesses will bear the brunt of the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Kichik bizneslar iqtisodiy tanazzulning eng yomon oqibatlarini his qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatning eng yomon oqibatlarini his qilish.

cards.ex: He implied a quid pro quo: funding in exchange for votes.
cards.exUz: U evaziga evazni nazarda tutdi: ovozlar evaziga moliyalashtirish.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa berish evaziga boshqa narsani talab qilish.

cards.ex: Financial advisors recommend that you diversify your investments.
cards.exUz: Moliyaviy maslahatchilar investitsiyalaringizni turlantirishni tavsiya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni kamaytirish uchun turli sohalarga pul tikish.

cards.ex: Proper asset allocation is crucial for long-term financial success.
cards.exUz: Uzoq muddatli moliyaviy muvaffaqiyat uchun to'g'ri aktiv taqsimoti juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Investitsiyalarni turli aktivlar orasida bo'lish strategiyasi.

cards.ex: The stock market has been on a bull run for the past five years.
cards.exUz: Aktsiya bozori so'nggi besh yil davomida o'sish davrida bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Aktsiya bozorida uzoq davom etgan o'sish tendentsiyasi.

cards.ex: Tech companies are riding the wave of artificial intelligence.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya kompaniyalari sun'iy intellekt to'lqinida suzishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatdan foydalanib, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: Be careful about loans with a large balloon payment at the end.
cards.exUz: Oxirida katta to'lovni o'z ichiga olgan kreditlardan ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Qarzning oxirida katta miqdordagi to'lov.

cards.ex: Interest accrues daily on the outstanding balance.
cards.exUz: Foiz qoldiq summaga har kuni hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan qarzga foiz qo'shilishi.

cards.ex: The government announced a fiscal stimulus package to boost the economy.
cards.exUz: Hukumat iqtisodiyotni rag'batlantirish uchun moliyaviy rag'bat paketini e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotni rag'batlantirish uchun hukumat xarajatlari yoki soliq imtiyozlari.

cards.ex: Cryptocurrencies have soared in value over the past few years.
cards.exUz: So'nggi bir necha yil ichida kriptovalyutalar qiymati oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiymati juda tez va yuqori darajaga ko'tarilishi.

cards.ex: Investing in a volatile market can be risky.
cards.exUz: O'zgaruvchan bozorda investitsiya qilish xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Narxlar tez va keskin o'zgarib turadigan bozor.

cards.ex: The company needs a cash injection to stay afloat.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya suzib yurish uchun pul quyishga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Biznes yoki iqtisodiyotga pul qo'shish.

cards.ex: The company managed to weather the storm of the recession.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya inqiroz bo'ronini yengishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin davrni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The tech industry is known for its cut-throat competition.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya sanoati o'zining keskin raqobati bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Juda agressiv va shafqatsiz raqobat.

cards.ex: The company's debt-to-equity ratio is quite high.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning qarz/kapital nisbati juda yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning qarzi va kapitali o'rtasidagi nisbat.

cards.ex: The prime lending rate has remained stable for several months.
cards.exUz: Asosiy foiz stavkasi bir necha oydan beri barqaror bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Banklar o'z mijozlariga beradigan eng past foiz stavkasi.

cards.ex: Greater regulatory oversight is needed to prevent financial fraud.
cards.exUz: Moliyaviy firibgarlikning oldini olish uchun yanada kuchli nazorat kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat tomonidan biznes faoliyatini nazorat qilish.
